title.narrative: Skill Up! Empowering vulnerable youth through competencies, decent income and inclusive & sustainable TVET structures

description.narrative: Overall ObjectiveThe economic stability and decent income generation of vulnerable young people have improved through profitable employment or self-employment, resulting in increased food and nutrition security.Project Objective: Young vulnerable people use the acquired (labour) market relevant competencies and the provided access to necessary resources & labour market linkages to secure (self-) employment opportunities.

Project Participants (Direct):The project will impart trainings to 1200 young people (gender disaggregated) on technical location specified green trades along with business, life, and digital literacy;200 rural service providers (gender disaggregated) will be trained on newly identified modules;120 high potential rural youth (gender disaggregated) will be trained on fast-track business accelerator programme.;5 Farmer Producer Organisations will be trained to strengthen their governance and financial systems and to become more independent.;60 people with disabilities and vulnerable youth (trafficking survivors, acid survivors etc.) (gender disaggregated) will be trained on technical location specified green trades along with business, life, and digital literacy and support in the form of scholarships.Project Participants (Indirect): The project will indirectly cater to 6000 participants/1200 households (households of 1200 x 5) in both the geographies-West Bengal and Jharkhand by enhancing their cash incomes at least 30%.

The project seeks to empower vulnerable youth, women and people with disability (PwDs) in the states of West Bengal and Jharkhand through enhancing competencies, contributing towards decent income and ensuring inclusive & sustainable TVET structures.
